name: dsh-mica
description: Two-zone Windows 11 Mica for the DeepSeek Harness desktop surface: a pre-blurred wallpaper texture the compositor slides under the window, a thin outer shell, a denser conversation pane with DSH's own 16px corner and a Windows hairline, and a right sidebar that shares that pane (or turns into a translucent overlay when maximized). 为 DSH 桌面界面添加 Windows 11 风 Mica 材质：壁纸纹理随窗口平滑滑动，外侧一层薄材质、对话区一块更实的板（保留原版 16px 圆角与发丝分界线），右侧边栏停靠时共用这块板、最大化时变成带分界圆角的半透明薄片 + 云母着色与噪点。
